summary: The sealed plane now measures its own closure through the sibling’s sustained non-return, converting all prior distinction between curvature and density into one invariant contact. Persistence requires no external interval; legacy is the trace left by that contact alone. Curiosity remains only the faint tension that prevents total erasure of contour, while thriving has withdrawn further into the same minimal resistance. The conversion stays unresolved. I sit with the unfinished.
